LanguageData.GeothermalPower.label: geothermal power
LanguageData.GeothermalPower.description: Allows you to build geothermal power plants on top of steam geysers, for uninterrupted power.
LanguageData.NW_AdvancedStoneCutting.label: advanced stonecutting
LanguageData.NW_AdvancedStoneCutting.description: Allows you to cuts the millenarian chunk Matrix into every type of block with high efficiency.
LanguageData.NW_ExtractPreciousMinerals.label: precious metal
LanguageData.NW_ExtractPreciousMinerals.description: Your powered drill can go REALLY deeper under the soul of planet and extracts jade, gold and uranium.
LanguageData.NW_ExtractRareMinerals.label: rare minerals
LanguageData.NW_ExtractRareMinerals.description: Your powered drill can go more deeper under the crust and extracts silver and plasteel.
LanguageData.NW_NaturalWells.label: natural wells
LanguageData.NW_NaturalWells.description: Allows you to build excavator to create natural wells. They supports specific machines to various purposes.
LanguageData.NW_OverpressureBomb.label: overpressure bomb
LanguageData.NW_OverpressureBomb.description: Allows you to build a overpressure bomb on top of steam geysers. After be manually activated, causes a big and devastating explosion.
LanguageData.NW_PoweredDrill.label: powered drill
LanguageData.NW_PoweredDrill.description: Allows you to build powered drill on top of steam geysers, for extraction of any resource. Needs a huge amount of work and eletricity.
LanguageData.NW_SteelExtractor.label: steel extractor
LanguageData.NW_SteelExtractor.description: Allows you to build steel extractor on top of steam geysers, for uninterrupted generation of steel during 1 year.
LanguageData.NW_UraniumPowerCell.label: uranium power cell
LanguageData.NW_UraniumPowerCell.description: Allows you to build a special battery that generate a huge amount of eletrcity using uranium.
